description:
Somos estudiantes de Formación Técnica en Biologia Marina interesados no unicamente en las Ciencias Naturales si no en la Tecnologia del Espacio buscando como relacionarlo con el mar.

Buscamos en este desafio, potenciar nuestras capacidades, creando herramientas digitales que nos permitan obtener parametros biologicos, fisicos y quimicos de manera creativa y sencilla mediante un enfoque sensorial.
summary: We developed a website that produces sounds and generates music from maps of the Earth. The project is important because it sparks interest in scientific fields such as geography and raises awareness among younger generations about the importance of the ocean and how it affects our lives to a greater extent than we may realize. It offers a different, educational experience through interactive activities that connect users with information by means of colors and sounds, presenting data in a more engaging way.
details:
Website Features and Structure

The website reads maps that display specific ocean-related data, such as ocean currents, water temperature, wind, rainfall, and humidity, among other variables. These data are represented using a color scale, which the website converts into sounds, creating sequences of musical notes. The website includes a home page that introduces the project, its objectives, the sections available, and instructions on how to use the platform. It also features a vertical menu that provides easy access to all available maps and website functions, organized into sections.

How the Sound Mapping Works

The website scans the selected map from left to right in 240 steps. At each step, it analyzes six bands running from north to south. Each map is interpreted according to its average color, brightness, color variety, contrast, and the proportion of the map area covered. In general, the colors produce sounds that reflect the sensations they evoke. For example, bright colors produce a bright timbre, while dark colors produce a rounded, soft timbre. The website provides a guide that explains in detail which sounds are assigned to each color based on its characteristics, making the process easier to understand.

Educational and Accessibility Benefits

The project helps primary school students engage with geography through map reading, with the added feature that they can explore maps through sound. To support this, we added a section where users can upload maps, generate sounds, and take part in more interactive, educational activities. The website is also designed to be accessible to children with a range of physical, emotional, social, and cognitive needs, including children with visual impairments and children on the autism spectrum.

The tools we used were Claude and Visual Studio Code for the programming, ChatGPT to translate the text into English, and Canva to create the presentation.
